name: universal-search
title: Universal Search
description: Search Obsidian vault notes, apps, files, bookmarks, contacts, calendar events, scripts, and photos from one command with image, PDF, Office, Parquet, and Mermaid previews.
author: fabian_erbach

preferences.name: obsidianVaultPath
preferences.title: Obsidian Vault Path
preferences.description: Absolute path to your Obsidian vault (markdown notes are searched here and excluded from file results).

preferences.name: enableObsidian
preferences.title: Sources
preferences.label: Obsidian Vault
preferences.description: Search markdown notes inside the configured vault.

preferences.name: enableFileContents
preferences.label: File Contents
preferences.description: Search inside file contents via Spotlight (excludes the Obsidian vault).

preferences.name: enableFileNames
preferences.label: File Names
preferences.description: Search files by name via Spotlight (excludes the Obsidian vault).

preferences.name: enableFolders
preferences.label: Folders
preferences.description: Search folders by name via Spotlight.

preferences.name: enableApplications
preferences.label: Applications
preferences.description: Search installed macOS Applications (name / bundle ID). Launch with Enter.

preferences.name: enableScriptCommands
preferences.label: Script Commands
preferences.description: Search Raycast-style Script Commands from the configured folder.

preferences.name: enableBookmarks
preferences.label: Safari Bookmarks
preferences.description: Search Safari bookmarks by title or URL.

preferences.name: enableContacts
preferences.label: Contacts
preferences.description: Search macOS Contacts (name / organisation / email / phone). Requires Raycast to be granted Contacts access in System Settings → Privacy & Security → Contacts.

preferences.name: enableEvents
preferences.label: Calendar Events
preferences.description: Search Calendar events (title / location / description). Requires Raycast to be granted Calendar access in System Settings → Privacy & Security → Calendars.

preferences.name: enablePhotos
preferences.label: Photos
preferences.description: Search Photos.app assets by filename, media type, date, and dimensions. Requires Raycast Full Disk Access.

preferences.name: photosLibraryPath
preferences.title: Photos Library Path
preferences.description: Path to the Photos library package. Universal Search reads its local database, so Raycast needs Full Disk Access.

preferences.name: scriptCommandsPath
preferences.title: Script Commands Path
preferences.description: Folder containing Raycast-style Script Commands.

preferences.name: eventLookbackDays
preferences.title: Event Lookback (days)
preferences.description: How many days into the past to include events from.

preferences.name: eventLookaheadDays
preferences.title: Event Lookahead (days)
preferences.description: How many days into the future to include events from.

preferences.name: maxPerSource
preferences.title: Max Results per Source
preferences.description: Fallback result cap for any source without its own limit below.

preferences.name: maxApplications
preferences.title: Max Applications
preferences.description: Optional result cap for Applications. Leave blank to use Max Results per Source.

preferences.name: maxScriptCommands
preferences.title: Max Script Commands
preferences.description: Optional result cap for Script Commands. Leave blank to use Max Results per Source.

preferences.name: maxFileContents
preferences.title: Max File Contents
preferences.description: Optional result cap for File Contents. Leave blank to use Max Results per Source.

preferences.name: maxFileNames
preferences.title: Max File Names
preferences.description: Optional result cap for File Names. Leave blank to use Max Results per Source.

preferences.name: maxFolders
preferences.title: Max Folders
preferences.description: Optional result cap for Folders. Leave blank to use Max Results per Source.

preferences.name: maxObsidian
preferences.title: Max Obsidian Vault
preferences.description: Optional result cap for Obsidian Vault. Leave blank to use Max Results per Source.

preferences.name: maxBookmarks
preferences.title: Max Safari Bookmarks
preferences.description: Optional result cap for Safari Bookmarks. Leave blank to use Max Results per Source.

preferences.name: maxContacts
preferences.title: Max Contacts
preferences.description: Optional result cap for Contacts. Leave blank to use Max Results per Source.

preferences.name: maxEvents
preferences.title: Max Calendar Events
preferences.description: Optional result cap for Calendar Events. Leave blank to use Max Results per Source.

preferences.name: maxPhotos
preferences.title: Max Photos
preferences.description: Optional result cap for Photos. Leave blank to use Max Results per Source.

preferences.name: showRecentItems
preferences.title: Recent Items
preferences.label: Show recent items on empty search
preferences.description: Show recently opened results when the search field is empty.

preferences.name: recentItemsCount
preferences.title: Recent Items Count
preferences.description: How many recent results to show when opening Universal Search.

preferences.name: priorityApplications
preferences.title: Applications Priority
preferences.description: Applications priority. Lower numbers appear first and win cross-section deduplication ties.

preferences.name: priorityFileContents
preferences.title: File Contents Priority
preferences.description: File Contents priority. Lower numbers appear first and win cross-section deduplication ties.

preferences.name: priorityScriptCommands
preferences.title: Script Commands Priority
preferences.description: Script Commands priority. Lower numbers appear first and win cross-section deduplication ties.

preferences.name: priorityFileNames
preferences.title: File Names Priority
preferences.description: File Names priority. Lower numbers appear first and win cross-section deduplication ties.

preferences.name: priorityFolders
preferences.title: Folders Priority
preferences.description: Folders priority. Lower numbers appear first and win cross-section deduplication ties.

preferences.name: priorityObsidian
preferences.title: Obsidian Vault Priority
preferences.description: Obsidian Vault priority. Lower numbers appear first and win cross-section deduplication ties.

preferences.name: priorityBookmarks
preferences.title: Safari Bookmarks Priority
preferences.description: Safari Bookmarks priority. Lower numbers appear first and win cross-section deduplication ties.

preferences.name: priorityContacts
preferences.title: Contacts Priority
preferences.description: Contacts priority. Lower numbers appear first and win cross-section deduplication ties.

preferences.name: priorityEvents
preferences.title: Calendar Events Priority
preferences.description: Calendar Events priority. Lower numbers appear first and win cross-section deduplication ties.

preferences.name: priorityPhotos
preferences.title: Photos Priority
preferences.description: Photos priority. Lower numbers appear first and win cross-section deduplication ties.

preferences.name: excludeGlobal
preferences.title: Exclude — All Sources
preferences.description: Comma-separated patterns applied to every source. Treated as path prefixes for files / folders / notes (supports ~) AND as URL substrings for bookmarks.

preferences.name: excludeFileContents
preferences.title: Exclude — File Contents
preferences.description: Comma-separated list of path prefixes to exclude from File Contents results (supports ~).

preferences.name: excludeFileNames
preferences.title: Exclude — File Names
preferences.description: Comma-separated list of path prefixes to exclude from File Names results (supports ~).

preferences.name: excludeFolders
preferences.title: Exclude — Folders
preferences.description: Comma-separated list of path prefixes to exclude from Folder results (supports ~).

preferences.name: excludeObsidian
preferences.title: Exclude — Obsidian Vault
preferences.description: Comma-separated list of path prefixes (inside the vault) to exclude from Note results (supports ~).

preferences.name: excludeBookmarks
preferences.title: Exclude — Safari Bookmarks
preferences.description: Comma-separated list of URL substrings (case-insensitive) to exclude from Bookmark results.

preferences.name: defaultEditor
preferences.title: Default Editor
preferences.description: Path or app name to open files with (⌘E). Accepts an absolute binary path (e.g. /opt/homebrew/bin/zed) or an .app bundle name (e.g. Zed).

preferences.name: showPreviewPath
preferences.title: Preview Header
preferences.label: Show path / URL
preferences.description: Display the file path or bookmark URL at the top of the preview pane.

preferences.name: showPreviewMetadata
preferences.label: Show modified · size
preferences.description: Display modified date and file size under the preview header.
